payload.text: CARRIED OUT OF TODO 34 ON 2026-09-22 WHEN THE 0.1.6 PROGRAM WAS ARCHIVED, BECAUSE THE PROGRAM SHIPPING DID NOT DISCHARGE ITS RESIDUE. Done and not in question: 0.1.6 is cut, published and swept into 13 estates, devbin itself is pushed and green, and its ledger reads 0 threads WIP, 0 work packages WIP, 0 open issues. What is still owed is owed to hv in person. (3) TWO measured questions of laksa/dc's are open: whether `pristine` should reach the Ubuntu 26 runner-migration notice, and whether it should reach the Elixir dependency warnings. Archiving 34 bare would have left "the 0.1.6 program shipped" standing as a true sentence carrying an untrue implication, which is the failure mode a flense invites.
